editorial:
Imagine escaping a messy divorce by heading to a beautiful ranch in California. That is exactly what Samantha does, and it is where she meets Tate, a rugged ranch hand who steals her heart. You will feel the sparks flying between them right away, but the mood shifts when Tate finds out Samantha's ex-husband is a rich, famous news anchor. The movie takes a heavy turn when Samantha suffers a terrible accident that leaves her paralyzed. You will find yourself rooting for her as she fights to walk and ride horses again, turning her pain into a way to help other children with disabilities.

The acting feels very natural, and the slow pace helps you really feel the emotion of the story. While some parts might feel a bit like an old soap opera, the heart of the film is in the recovery process. If you enjoy stories about second chances and overcoming the odds, you will love this. Since it is an older title, you might want to look for a high-quality digital rental on Apple TV or track down a physical DVD to keep in your collection for those cozy nights in.
endingExplained: After losing her best friend and fighting her own paralysis, Samantha finds peace by running a riding school. Tate finally comes back to the ranch after hearing about Caroline's death. He sees how strong Samantha has become and realizes his pride was the only thing keeping them apart. They forgive each other for the past and decide to give their love another chance, ending the movie on a happy, hopeful note.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heartwarming stories about recovery and love.
